locations.note: Guybrush Threepwood starts his pirate career on Mêlée Island, an invented island in a Caribbean of the age of piracy.

Mêlée Island's town, with its gates, half-timbered houses and the Plönlein-like corner, is widely held to be drawn after Rothenburg ob der Tauber; Ron Gilbert has called the resemblance a coincidence.
